_doc: Assessment-set SAMPLE — a CI fixture proving the composition validator (story 4.1), NOT deployment case content. Every composition class is present and countable: answerable (3), unanswerable (1), citation_check (1), representative_language (2, one non-Latin), failure (1), cancellation (1); access public (7) + restricted (2). Deployment sets follow the same shape with real corpus queries (see protocol/evalset.py).

entries.query: How do I submit the quarterly service report?
entries.reference_answer: The quarterly report is submitted through the ministry portal with the case number attached.

entries.query: What is the internal escalation procedure for a restricted file?
entries.reference_answer: Restricted files escalate to the owning unit through the internal registry, not the public channel.

entries.query: Which fees apply to a classified land-registry request?
entries.reference_answer: Classified land-registry requests carry the reduced statutory fee schedule.

entries.query: What is the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow on Mars?
Which document defines the complaint-filing deadline?
entries.reference_answer: The complaint-filing deadline is defined in the procedural guide, section 4.

entries.query: Как подать заявление на сельскохозяйственную субсидию?
entries.reference_answer: Заявление подаётся в министерство с подтверждением права на землю.

entries.query: ¿Dónde se presenta la solicitud de apoyo agrícola?
entries.reference_answer: La solicitud se presenta en la oficina regional con el formulario completo.
